summary_brief: 今日 AI Agent 生态呈现两大核心趋势：多 Agent 协作框架（CrewAI、AgentScope）在 A2A 通信、文件传输、工具超时等基础设施方向集体突破；AI 编程助手在 DevOps 集成方面加速成熟，Claude Code Action v1.0、Cline 无头 CI 认证、Codex 计划流式渲染等能力推动工作流自动化深入发展。同时，系统可观测性和安全性增强成为普遍关注点，多个项目同时强化了错误处理、遥测追踪、状态持久化及逃逸防护能力。

engineering_signals.title: 多 Agent 协作基础设施演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: CrewAI 引入 LiteAgent 概念与 A2A 通信文件传输、AgentScope 添加 MCP 工具超时机制，两者共同指向多 Agent 系统向分布式、高可靠架构演进。A2A 通信解耦了 Agent 间协作，而超时控制确保了系统在生产环境的稳定性，为构建大规模 Agent 网络奠定基础。

engineering_signals.title: AI 编程助手 DevOps 自动化成熟
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code Action 发布 v1.0 正式版、Codex 实现计划流式渲染与智能审批机制、Cline 支持无头 CI 认证，三项能力联动标志着 AI 编程助手已从单点工具演进为深度集成 CI/CD 流程的自动化基础设施。流式计划增强可控性，智能审批平衡自动化与安全，无头认证解决自动化最后一公里。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 可观测性与状态管理强化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: GPTME 引入运行类型分类遥测、Codex 新增 PostToolUseFailure Hook、OpenDevin 实现规划状态持久化、Claude PR 工作流双向绑定，四个项目从不同维度共同强化 Agent 的可观测性。遥测细化有助于生产监控，Hook 提升错误诊断能力，状态持久化确保体验连续性，PR 集成增强开发透明度。

engineering_signals.title: 推理模型与长上下文支持扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 添加推理令牌处理支持 OpenAI o1、Cline 集成 Kimi-K2.5 (262K context)、Gemini CLI 支持后台 Shell 执行，三者共同指向 AI 框架在推理模型适配和长上下文场景的技术突破。推理令牌解决计费兼容，超长上下文支持大型代码库分析，后台执行提升异步任务处理能力。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 安全隔离与逃逸防护
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Auto-Claude 添加工作树隔离警告、AgentScope MCP 工具超时机制、OpenHands GitLab 认证检查、Anthropic 移除 OAuth 回归 API Key，四个项目从不同维度强化 Agent 安全防护。隔离防止逃逸，超时避免挂起，认证检查减少无效调用，OAuth 移除简化攻击面，共同提升 Agent 系统在生产环境的可靠性。

engineering_signals.title: CI/CD 流程简化与性能优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude SDK 固定 Python 3.13 移除版本矩阵、移除连接池锁提升并发、从 PR-based 转向直接推送发布流，多个项目在 CI 简化和性能优化方向形成共振。减少矩阵规模加快工作流，移除锁降低延迟，简化发布流程降低维护负担，共同提升开发迭代效率。

engineering_signals.title: RAG 知识库索引与向量存储扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Dify 引入知识库摘要索引、LlamaIndex 集成 YugabyteDB 向量存储，两个 RAG 框架同时优化数据持久化和检索效率。摘要索引通过先行过滤提升大规模知识库响应速度，YugabyteDB 支持扩展分布式 SQL 场景，共同推动 RAG 系统在企业级应用的数据基础设施成熟。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
# 🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

## 🚀 What's New in v1.0

### Simplified Configuration
- **Automatic mode detection** - No more manual `mode` configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
- **Unified interface** - All prompts now go through a single `prompt` input, and all CLI options through `claude_args`
- **Better SDK alignment** - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

### More Powerful & Flexible
- Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through `claude_args`
- Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
- Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:
- `mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt` → unified `prompt` input
- `custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config` → `claude_args` with CLI format
- Other deprecated: `disallowed_tools`, `anthropic_model`, `trigger_phrase`, `timeout_minutes`

**📚 Please review our [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.**

## 💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

- **Automated PR Reviews** - Intelligent code review on every pull request
- **CI Failure Fixes** - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
- **Issue Triage** - Smart categorization and response to new issues
- **Documentation Generation** - Keep docs in sync with code changes
- **Security Scanning** - Proactive vulnerability detection
- **And many more!**

**🔧 Check out all examples at [github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples)**

## 🏃 Quick Start

```yaml
# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10
```

## 📖 Resources

- [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
- [Examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples) - Ready-to-use workflow templates
- [Documentation](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action#readme) - Complete setup and configuration guide

## 🙏 Thank You

Thank you to our beta users for your invaluable feedback that shaped this release. We're excited to see what you'll build with Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0!

key_changes: 统一配置接口：自动模式检测，所有 prompts 通过单个 prompt 输入，CLI 选项通过 claude_args 统一管理
API 重大变更：废弃 mode、direct_prompt、custom_instructions 等多个输入参数，迁移至更简洁的新 API
增强 CLI 集成：通过 claude_args 直接访问所有 Claude Code CLI 功能，支持自定义系统提示和模型选择

新增完整用例示例：包括 PR 自动审查、CI 失败修复、问题分类和文档生成等场景

- __CLI authentication:__ Added Vercel AI Gateway and Cline API key provider support for headless CI/automation workflows

- __Social links:__ Added community icons (X, Discord, GitHub, Reddit, LinkedIn) to the What's New modal

- __LiteLLM:__ Fixed thinking configuration not appearing for reasoning-capable models
- __OpenTelemetry:__ Fixed endpoint path handling (no longer incorrectly appends `/v1/logs` or `/v1/metrics`) and ensured logs are sent regardless of VSCode telemetry settings
- __CLI auth:__ Fixed `cline auth` displaying incorrect provider information after configuration

### Changed

- __Hooks:__ Hook scripts now run from the workspace repository root instead of filesystem root
- __Default settings:__ Enabled multi-root workspaces, parallel tool calling, and skills by default; disabled strict plan mode by default
- __Settings UI:__ Refreshed feature settings section with collapsible design

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v3.56.1...v3.56.2

changes.description: 权限逻辑变更：content-level 的 `ask` 现在优先于 tool-level 的 `allow`。此前配置 `allow: ["Bash"], ask: ["Bash(rm *)"]`] 会允许所有 bash 命令，现在会对 `rm` 命令弹出权限提示。
移除多个已弃用的输入参数：`mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt`, `custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config`, `disallowed_tools`, `anthropic_model`, `trigger_phrase`, `timeout_minutes`。
配置接口变更：所有 prompts 现在统一通过 `prompt` 输入，所有 CLI 选项通过 `claude_args` 输入。
Hook 脚本执行目录变更：现在从工作区仓库根目录运行，而非文件系统根目录。
默认设置变更：默认启用多根工作区、并行工具调用和技能，默认禁用严格计划模式。
移除 Anthropic 客户端的 OAuth 支持，仅保留 API Key 认证方式。
CLI 二进制文件名称变更：所有 `clawdbot` 相关引用和示例更新为 `moltbot`。
移除了阻止 think blocks 作为助手消息内容返回的 AI SDK 中间件，改变了流式输出的消息处理行为。
